args:
set -uo pipefail

ts=$(date -u +%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ)
work=/work
failed=0
done_count=0

# Workload Identity のトークンで GCS の JSON API に直接置く（gcloud を入れない）
upload() {
  local file=$1 name=$2 type=$3 token
  token=$(curl -sSf -H 'Metadata-Flavor: Google' \
    'http://metadata.google.internal/computeMetadata/v1/instance/service-accounts/default/token' \
    | ruby -rjson -e 'print JSON.parse(STDIN.read)["access_token"]') || return 1
  [ -n "${token}" ] || return 1
  curl -sSf --retry 3 -o /dev/null -X POST \
    -H "Authorization: Bearer ${token}" -H "Content-Type: ${type}" \
    -T "${file}" \
    "https://storage.googleapis.com/upload/storage/v1/b/${BUCKET}/o?uploadType=media&name=${name//\//%2F}"
}

# ---- DB ----
# 対象の一覧: "<ns> <pod> <container> <engine>"
targets=$(kubectl get pods -A -o json | ruby -rjson -e '
  JSON.parse(STDIN.read)["items"].each do |pod|
    meta = pod["metadata"]
    next if meta.dig("annotations", "wax100.io/backup") == "false"
    next unless pod.dig("status", "phase") == "Running"
    ready = (pod.dig("status", "containerStatuses") || []).to_h { |s| [s["name"], s["ready"]] }
    (pod.dig("spec", "containers") || []).each do |c|
      m = c["image"].to_s.match(%r{(?:\A|/)(?:library/)?(postgres|mysql)[:@]})
      next unless m && ready[c["name"]]
      puts [meta["namespace"], meta["name"], c["name"], m[1]].join(" ")
    end
  end
') || { echo "ERROR: Pod の一覧を取れませんでした"; targets=""; failed=1; }

while read -r ns pod container engine; do
  [ -n "${ns}" ] || continue
  out="${work}/${ns}_${pod}.sql.gz"
  echo "== ${ns}/${pod} (${engine})"

  case "${engine}" in
    postgres)
      # 変数は DB コンテナの中で展開させる。stdin は while read の入力を食わないよう塞ぐ
      # shellcheck disable=SC2016
      kubectl exec -n "${ns}" "${pod}" -c "${container}" -- sh -c \
        'PGPASSWORD="${POSTGRES_PASSWORD:-}" pg_dumpall --clean --if-exists -U "${POSTGRES_USER:-postgres}"' \
        < /dev/null | gzip > "${out}"
      rc=$?
      trailer='-- PostgreSQL database cluster dump complete'
      ;;
    mysql)
      # shellcheck disable=SC2016
      kubectl exec -n "${ns}" "${pod}" -c "${container}" -- sh -c \
        'mysqldump -uroot -p"${MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD}" --all-databases --single-transaction --routines --events --triggers' \
        < /dev/null | gzip > "${out}"
      rc=$?
      trailer='-- Dump completed'
      ;;
  esac

  if [ "${rc}" != "0" ] || ! gzip -t "${out}" \
     || ! zcat "${out}" | tail -n 5 | grep -q -- "${trailer}"; then
    echo "ERROR: ${ns}/${pod} のダンプに失敗しました"
    failed=1
  elif upload "${out}" "${ns}/${pod}/${ts}.sql.gz" application/gzip; then
    echo "ok: gs://${BUCKET}/${ns}/${pod}/${ts}.sql.gz ($(stat -c %s "${out}") bytes)"
    done_count=$((done_count + 1))
  else
    echo "ERROR: ${ns}/${pod} のアップロードに失敗しました"
    failed=1
  fi
  rm -f "${out}"
done <<< "${targets}"

# ---- アプリ定義 ----
namespaces=$(kubectl get ns -l 'app.kubernetes.io/managed-by!=configmanagement.gke.io' \
  -o jsonpath='{.items[*].metadata.name}') || { echo "ERROR: Namespace の一覧を取れませんでした"; namespaces=""; failed=1; }

for ns in ${namespaces}; do
  case " ${EXCLUDED_NAMESPACES} " in *" ${ns} "*) continue ;; esac
  case "${ns}" in gke-managed-*|gmp-*) continue ;; esac

  out="${work}/${ns}.yaml.gz"
  kubectl get "${KINDS}" -n "${ns}" -o json --show-managed-fields=false \
    | ruby -rjson -ryaml -e '
        list = JSON.parse(STDIN.read)
        exit 3 if list["items"].empty?
        list["items"].each do |o|
          o.delete("status")
          m = o["metadata"]
          %w[resourceVersion uid creationTimestamp generation selfLink managedFields].each { |k| m.delete(k) }
          if (a = m["annotations"])
            %w[deployment.kubernetes.io/revision kubectl.kubernetes.io/last-applied-configuration
               kubectl.kubernetes.io/restartedAt].each { |k| a.delete(k) }
            m.delete("annotations") if a.empty?
          end
        end
        print list.to_yaml
      ' | gzip > "${out}"
  rcs=("${PIPESTATUS[@]}")

  if [ "${rcs[1]}" = "3" ]; then
    rm -f "${out}"
    continue
  fi
  if [ "${rcs[0]}" != "0" ] || [ "${rcs[1]}" != "0" ] || ! gzip -t "${out}"; then
    echo "ERROR: ${ns} の定義を取り出せませんでした"
    failed=1
  elif upload "${out}" "manifests/${ns}/${ts}.yaml.gz" application/gzip; then
    echo "ok: gs://${BUCKET}/manifests/${ns}/${ts}.yaml.gz"
    done_count=$((done_count + 1))
  else
    echo "ERROR: ${ns} の定義のアップロードに失敗しました"
    failed=1
  fi
  rm -f "${out}"
done

echo "完了: ${done_count} 件"
exit "${failed}"

env.name: EXCLUDED_NAMESPACES
env.value: kube-system kube-public kube-node-lease default canine canine-k8s-builder infra external-secrets kyverno reloader config-management-system config-management-monitoring resource-group-system

containers.name: backup
